_about: Scheduled tasks that fire into the day's scanner session. Recreated every night by the journal saver, pointed at a fresh session (persistent_session_id). Names are stable; the saver finds the current scanner session through the 'VWAP scanner end of day' task.

triggers.name: VWAP scanner morning reset
triggers.prompt:
VWAP scanner morning reset (scheduled by the user). Work in /home/user/options-debate-desk (if missing: git clone https://github.com/mohmedgann92-web/options-debate-desk /home/user/options-debate-desk). Never commit or push; do not mention git in replies.
1) git fetch origin claude/vwap-scanner-tradingview && git checkout claude/vwap-scanner-tradingview && git reset --hard origin/claude/vwap-scanner-tradingview
2) Run: python3 tv_vwap_scanner.py plan --interval 5. If "trading_day" is false, reply "No session today: <reason>" and stop.
3) Run: python3 tv_vwap_scanner.py reset
4) Reply with one line: "Reset for <date>: <ticks_expected> ticks, <session_et> ET".

triggers.name: VWAP tick :31
triggers.prompt:
VWAP scanner tick (scheduled by the user). Do exactly this, nothing else (no code edits, no git, no commentary):
1) Call mcp__Trading_View__mcp-tv-get-symbol-data-batch with symbols ["AMEX:SPY","NASDAQ:QQQ","NASDAQ:INTC","NASDAQ:SNDK","NASDAQ:COIN","NASDAQ:NVDA","NYSE:ORCL","NASDAQ:SQQQ","NASDAQ:TQQQ","AMEX:SOXL"] and columns ["close","volume","high","low"].
2) Pipe the full JSON result into: cd /home/user/options-debate-desk && python3 tv_vwap_scanner.py tick --interval 5 --claim <<'JSON' (the JSON) JSON
3) For EACH output line starting with "ALERT ", call PushNotification with status "proactive" and the rest of the line as the message. Do not push BLOCKED lines.
4) Reply with only the last output line.
